Who this is for

For people who've tried
tracking — and stopped.

You already know what you want to change. The hard part isn't motivation — it's friction. It's the app that turns into a chore. The streak that makes you feel worse when you break it. The data that tells you what happened but never why.

Forged is for people who think in patterns. Who want to actually understand their behaviour, not just record it. Who'd rather spend 30 seconds logging something real than 10 minutes fighting an interface.

Other apps track what happened. Forged helps you understand why — and what to do next.

How it works

Up and running
in sixty seconds.

01

Pick what you're working on

Set up your habits in under a minute. Forged handles daily, weekly, targets, and limits — whatever shape your goal actually is.

02

Log in seconds, reflect when it matters

One tap to check off. A voice note or quick line when something's worth capturing. The journal is where the coach learns what the data can't tell it.

03

Ask the coach why

After a few weeks, ask what's actually been holding you back. The coach has read everything you wrote — and it won't give you generic answers.

04

Bring someone in

Add an accountability partner. Share a goal. Know when they've logged — and let them know when you haven't.
